structuralDispositions.subject: ServerBoundaryTest shared domain-service host reference guard
structuralDispositions.rationale: The scaffold-era no-host premise became a positive shared-host assertion while forbidden dependency checks remained.

structuralDispositions.subject: ScaffoldSmokeTest project-reference boundary direction guard
structuralDispositions.rationale: The exact-set guard was updated to require the shared host SDK reference without relaxing unrelated boundaries.

structuralDispositions.subject: Residual internal governance audit gate fail-closed-on-sink-failure
structuralDispositions.rationale: The live fail-closed behavior was surfaced into GovernanceAuditSinkFailClosedConformanceTest instead of retired.

structuralDispositions.subject: Redundant command-status idempotency bridge shim and its unit test
structuralDispositions.rationale: The shim had zero production references and returned the same retryable uncertainty decision for every input; the base-class dispatch/replay teeth test offsets the removed unit test.

structuralDispositions.subject: Genuine Conversations idempotency contract and replay verification
structuralDispositions.rationale: The explicit reserve/replay/conflict lifecycle and replay-verification rules remain domain logic not supplied by the base class.

structuralDispositions.subject: Hand-rolled HMAC-SHA256 list continuation cursor codec
structuralDispositions.rationale: Cursor integrity moved to the platform protected-cursor codec while domain lifetime, offset, and generation guards remained.

structuralDispositions.subject: HMAC-specific cursor fail-closed tests and ForgeCursorWithOffset helper
structuralDispositions.rationale: The same safe Hidden or Forbidden outcomes are asserted through the platform cursor codec; scope-binding checks gained zero-read assertions.

structuralDispositions.subject: Conversation-specific query logic and Contracts/Queries DTOs
structuralDispositions.rationale: Filter, freshness, hydration, temporal reconstruction, and public query DTO behavior remained Conversations-owned.

structuralDispositions.subject: FR-5 disposition correction from remove-and-replace to greenfield-adopt
structuralDispositions.rationale: There was no bespoke read-model persistence code to delete; the story added the platform store and production binding.

structuralDispositions.subject: ServerBoundaryTest Dapr.Client assembly-metadata clause
structuralDispositions.rationale: The shared store legitimately requires DaprClient registration, so the guard became a required-presence assertion while the direct package-reference prohibition stayed.

structuralDispositions.subject: Projection read model field-selection, freshness DTOs, and fail-closed boundary
structuralDispositions.rationale: The persisted value rides existing public projection DTOs and the fail-closed read assertions remain green through the production store path.

structuralDispositions.subject: FR-6 projection-orchestration inventory label correction
structuralDispositions.rationale: The platform projection seam already existed, so the story consumed it without relabeling or remeasuring the accepted inventory area.

structuralDispositions.subject: ConversationProjectionMaterializer conversation-specific materialization logic
structuralDispositions.rationale: Conversation-specific replay, freshness, search trust, command eligibility, and evidence construction stayed as the shared in-module materialization entry point.

structuralDispositions.subject: ConversationProjectionMaterializerTest plumbing-only rows and live freshness oracle
structuralDispositions.rationale: Because the materializer entry point stayed reachable, retiring these assertions would have dropped still-live coverage.

structuralDispositions.subject: FR-8 generic serialization converters consume target re-scoped
structuralDispositions.rationale: The named shared converter and source-generation context surfaces did not yet exist and were deferred to Story 3.6 through the changeLog.

structuralDispositions.subject: Within-area reclassification of generic serialization converters
structuralDispositions.rationale: Prefixed identifier converters encode a domain rule, while value-base skeletons remain the future generic replacement target.

structuralDispositions.subject: TypeMapper consume evaluation and wire-shape oracle
structuralDispositions.rationale: Adopting TypeMapper would require public contract changes, so the exact wire-shape oracle stayed as the future replacement target.

structuralDispositions.subject: FR-9 verified gap for named shared test-support duplicate targets
structuralDispositions.rationale: The named duplicates did not exist in-module, so there was nothing to delete or replace.

structuralDispositions.subject: duplicate-test-fakes inventory correction for RepositoryTestContext
structuralDispositions.rationale: RepositoryTestContext is a source-tree path locator with no shared data-store fake equivalent; the correction is recorded through the inventory changeLog.

structuralDispositions.subject: Shared fake consume preservation and DomainResultAssertions negative finding
structuralDispositions.rationale: The genuine InMemoryReadModelStore consume from Story 2.4 is preserved, and shared assertion helpers were weaker than the existing exact assertions.

structuralDispositions.subject: FR-15 telemetry scaffolding helper promoted to Commons diagnostics
structuralDispositions.rationale: Conversations telemetry wrappers now delegate generic scaffolding to the shared helper while retaining metric names and domain vocabulary.

structuralDispositions.subject: Story 1.3 telemetry/status retarget obligation
structuralDispositions.rationale: Telemetry suites exercise the promoted helper through live wrappers, while status classification remains Conversations-owned.

structuralDispositions.subject: Conformance.Tests to Server project-reference disposition after Story 3.3
structuralDispositions.rationale: The project reference remains necessary because release-gate checks still use Server-owned tenant access, projection, command-handler, governance, and diagnostics-classifier types.
